title: Rate Card: Expedite Rate per Unit by Business Days Pulled In — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Rate card.** For Factory Production Orders, the per-unit rate of an expedited build depends on how far the expedite pulls the order in, taken as the business days counted from the day after the expedited target ship date up to and including the order's current ship date:

| Business days pulled in | Rate per unit |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | 70 dollars |
| 6 to 14 | the class expedite fee per unit (45.00 in the Custom Size Build class, 55.00 in the Custom Color Build class) |
| 5 or fewer | 40 dollars |

The expedited target ship date is the request date plus the class expedite lead time in business days, counted starting the day after the request date. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays. The current ship date is the one on the factory order record when the fee is fixed.

## Edges of the bands

- 15 business days pulled in: 70 dollars; 14: the class fee per unit.
- 6 business days pulled in: the class fee per unit; 5: 40 dollars.
- A current ship date on or before the expedited target date pulls the order in by no business days, which falls in the 5-or-fewer band.

## Hypothetical example (no federal holiday in the period)

A Custom Size Build order's expedited target ship date is a Wednesday and its current ship date is the Wednesday three weeks later. Counting from the Thursday after the target date up to and including that later Wednesday gives 15 business days, so the rate is 70 dollars per unit.
